# WIR0 golden fixture — shared cross-language court corpus (arcus ringbuf + cgap wire-shm + cgap-beam aq_slab).
# Framing law: 16B BE slot header [u32 magic "WIR0"][u32 crc32][u32 payload_len][u32 ordinal],
# BOOK_LEN=4096, SLOT_LEN=4096, MAX_PAYLOAD=4080, capacity at book offset 8 (u32 BE),
# next_ordinal at book offset 0 (u64 BE), validation order MAGIC -> ORDINAL -> LEN -> BUDGET -> CRC.
# SELF-PIN LAW: sha256 over every case line (non-'#', non-blank) concatenated verbatim WITH
# trailing newline, i.e. exactly as they appear in this file. Must equal the pin below.
# Any un-mirrored edit to a case line flips this hash and reds ALL THREE courts immediately.
# pin: f01cdb98e304ce8fded74e187a4b0b28839b73853d2c77966ccec66496278576
# Case grammar (whitespace-separated):
#   cap <n>                                  (reserved; per-case cap is carried inline)
#   pos <name> <cap> <ordinal> <payload_hex|-> <header_hex>
#       stamp payload at ordinal under cap; stamped header must equal header_hex
#       byte-exact; read must return payload_hex.
#   neg <name> <cap> <ordinal> <header_hex> <payload_hex|-> <STAGE>
#       write header_hex+payload_hex raw into slot ordinal%cap; read at ordinal
#       must refuse with the STAGE-named law as the FIRST failure:
#       MAGIC|ORDINAL|LEN|BUDGET|CRC. BUDGET semantics: the reader budget is
#       HEADER_LEN + payload_len - 1 (plen is wire-valid; only the budget is short).
#   seg <name> <cap> <segment_hex>
#       full segment image (book + cap slots); open-from-bytes, read stamped
#       ordinals, assert next_ordinal == 12 (full_segment) / payload byte-exact.
# Boundary legs (p09 wire-selection court, KD-G17 do-not-unify):
#   neg neg64_crc ...   a lawful 64B-header slot (16B prefix magic|crc|plen|ord,
#       crc stamped over payload-at-offset-64 per the parked 64B proposal);
#       the 16B reader computes crc over payload-at-16 and must refuse at CRC
#       (expected = stored 64B-layout crc, found = crc over the 16B-offset bytes).
#   segbad64 <name> <cap> <segment_hex>
#       full segment image laid out with slot_len=64 (book + cap*64B slots);
#       open-from-bytes must REFUSE at attach (capacity-vs-size law: a 64B-slot
#       arena is not a lawful WIR0 segment). Derived by RUNNING Go stdlib
#       (hash/crc32 + BE encoding of the parked 64B layout), 2026-11-06.
# Derived by RUNNING arcus internal/ringbuf (StampFrame/CreateFramed) — never hand-computed.
